  "test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection2",
  "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedFormattersForStructAndRecordCarryExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TestNamespace\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public struct MyStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record MyRecord\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public record struct MyRecordStruct\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public struct MyStringKeyStruct\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public record MyStringKeyRecord\n    {\n        public int Value { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkRefs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> msgPackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        MetadataReference[] references = frameworkRefs.Concat(msgPackRefs).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation output, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics);\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics);\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.Empty(output.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? excludeAttrSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeAttrSymbol);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? formatterInterfaceSymbol = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\");\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterInterfaceSymbol);\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> allTypes = GetAllTypes(output.Assembly.GlobalNamespace).ToList();\n\n        string[] targetTypeNames =\n        {\n            \"TestNamespace.MyStruct\",\n            \"TestNamespace.MyRecord\",\n            \"TestNamespace.MyRecordStruct\",\n            \"TestNamespace.MyStringKeyStruct\",\n            \"TestNamespace.MyStringKeyRecord\",\n        };\n\n        foreach (string targetTypeName in targetTypeNames)\n        {\n            INamedTypeSymbol? targetType = output.GetTypeByMetadataName(targetTypeName);\n            Assert.NotNull(targetType);\n\n            INamedTypeSymbol expectedInterface = formatterInterfaceSymbol!.Construct(targetType!);\n            List<INamedTypeSymbol> formatters = allTypes\n                .Where(t => t.TypeKind == TypeKind.Class && t.AllInterfaces.Any(i => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(i, expectedInterface)))\n                .ToList();\n\n            Assert.NotEmpty(formatters);\n\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol formatter in formatters)\n            {\n                Assert.Contains(\n                    formatter.GetAttributes(),\n                    attr => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(attr.AttributeClass, excludeAttrSymbol));\n\n                SyntaxReference syntaxRef = Assert.Single(formatter.DeclaringSyntaxReferences);\n                string generatedSource = syntaxRef.SyntaxTree.ToString();\n                Assert.Contains(\"[global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]\", generatedSource, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetAllTypes(INamespaceSymbol ns)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in ns.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return type;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in GetNestedTypes(type))\n            {\n                yield return nested;\n            }\n        }\n\n        foreach (INamespaceSymbol childNs in ns.GetNamespaceMembers())\n        {\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol type in GetAllTypes(childNs))\n            {\n                yield return type;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static IEnumerable<INamedTypeSymbol> GetNestedTypes(INamedTypeSymbol type)\n    {\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol nested in type.GetTypeMembers())\n        {\n            yield return nested;\n            foreach (INamedTypeSymbol inner in GetNestedTypes(nested))\n            {\n                yield return inner;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
